name: Fragments of the Life of a Formidable Boy
original_name: Retalhos da Vida de um Formidável Rapaz
overview: “Fragments of the Life of a Formidable Boy” is the new column of A Psique de Guilherme, in which Guilherme Gomes proposes to rescue and critically comment on some pieces of audiovisual material that he created throughout his childhood and early adolescence.
